units.title: Operator Decision Fatigue and Bias Modeling
gaps: No operator decision-fatigue model anywhere in mcp-server/src (all fatigue engines are metal fatigue)
Existing detectBiases implementations audit AI reasoning, not operator override/edit patterns
No physics-grounded mitigation engine keyed on operator state (only skill-based autoOperatorSkillMatch)
No anonymized JM Die operator-log dataset for the mandatory validation criterion (bounded search; PII gate required for acquisition)
No prism_ai / prism_safety wiring (nothing exists to wire)
units.nextAction: Resolve the validation-data blocker first (scope to synthetic+literature validation as [SCOPED], or sequence a PII-gated operator-log ingestion unit); then build one OperatorDecisionFatigueEngine consuming existing scheduling overtime/shift signals, generalize the MetaAIOrchestrationEngine detectBiases pattern to operator actions, add a fatigue-band mitigation table, and wire to prism_ai + prism_safety in the same commit.
